All 75 colourway alpha masks match their unsuffixed sources exactly. Props were inspected directly over unchanged summer grass at 1x/4x as well as mounted. Verified and inspected the summer grass in a literal 3x3 repeat, including enlarged junctions; it is existing context, not a new Part C output. There are no seasonal city files in Parts A-C, so seasonal-ground/seasonal-silhouette tests are not applicable; colourways are not seasonal partners. Primary street and five-storey proof entries pass because they do not enable wall ends or hanging signs. All 129 PNGs and compose.py remained byte-identical to the critic's starting hashes.
